# Sniffy — agent-buyable ASO intelligence (x402)

> App Store / Play Store optimization reports an AI agent can buy autonomously: no account, no API key, no subscription. The paid endpoint returns a real HTTP 402 with a machine-readable x402 offer; payment settles in USDC on Morph Mainnet (eip155:2818) at $0.05-$1.00 per report. Every report field carries a provenance label (live | cached | fixture | inferred).

## Why per-request beats a subscription

- Sniffy standard report: $0.20 per request, settled in seconds over x402; expert tier $1.00; quick scan $0.05.
- Incumbent ASO data access starts at ~$166/mo (AppTweak API floor), $15-549/mo dashboards, or $30k+/yr contracts (Sensor Tower) - all requiring a human with a credit card.
- An agent holding USDC completes the whole flow without a human: quote -> 402 offer -> sign (EIP-3009) -> report. As of 2026-06-10 no other agent-payable ASO diagnosis exists.

## API (base: https://gosniffyscraper-production.up.railway.app)

- GET /api/v1/aso/sample: free fixture report, full paid shape, always works - inspect before paying.
- POST /api/v1/aso/quote: free - detects the app, returns a shallow-scan teaser + the priced offer. Send the X-Sniffy-Client header.
- POST /api/v1/aso/diagnose: paid - HTTP 402 with the offer (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, Base64 JSON); retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for the full report + settlement receipt (PAYMENT-RESPONSE header).
- GET /openapi.json: OpenAPI 3.0 contract generated from the live validation schemas.
- GET /llms.txt: this file, served from the API origin too.

## How to pay (x402 V2)

1. POST /diagnose with app + keywords + country -> 402 with the offer.
2. Sign an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for the quoted USDC amount on Morph Mainnet (eip155:2818). Facilitator: https://morph-rails.morph.network/x402.
3. Retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Payments are non-refundable - check the free quote first.

## Install paths

- Agent Skill: npx skills add TheoInTech/asosniffy-com (SKILL.md is the canonical API reference)
- MCP server (sniffy_quote / sniffy_diagnose / sniffy_sample): @gosniffy/mcp
- CLI: npx sniffy quote|diagnose|sample (@gosniffy/cli)
- Typed TS SDK: @gosniffy/sdk (exports PaymentRequiredError for x402 interception)
- Free ASO knowledge MCP (no payment): @gosniffy/aso-knowledge
